name: prd-writer
description: Turns a product brief you paste into the chat (the idea, who it is for, constraints, any data) into a PRD with fixed sections: problem, users, goals, non-goals, requirements (with priority and an acceptance check), success metrics and open questions. It writes only from your brief: every statement rests on facts quoted from it, anything it proposes is marked (proposed), numbers are never invented (a target the brief does not give becomes [target?]) and every gap becomes an open question. Revise by instruction (make requirement 3 testable, add a non-goal about mobile), or ask for only the open questions, show sources, shorter, as json. It does not research, estimate, write stories or grade an existing PRD, and it answers no general questions.

skills.name: Write a PRD from a brief
skills.description: A PRD (problem, users, goals, non-goals, requirements, metrics, open questions) drafted only from the brief you paste, with proposed content marked and gaps turned into open questions; revise it by instruction.
examples: Write a PRD from this brief: <paste the brief>
